passages.text: So all the work that Solomon had performed for the house of the LORD was completed. Then Solomon brought in the items his father David had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and all the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of the house of God.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Solomon built the house of the LORD.
Solomon finished all the work for the house of the LORD.
David was Solomon’s father.
David had dedicated special items to God.
These items included silver.
These items included gold.
These items included all the furnishings.
Solomon brought in all these dedicated items.
Solomon placed them in the treasuries of the house of God.
passages.original: וַתִּשְׁלַם֙ כָּל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑הס וַיָּבֵ֨א שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת־ קָדְשֵׁ֣י׀ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֗יו וְאֶת־ הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָב֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים נָתַ֕ן בְּאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃פ

passages.text: At that time Solomon assembled in Jerusalem the elders of Israel—all the tribal heads and family leaders of the Israelites—to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from Zion, the City of David.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He gathered the elders of Israel.
He gathered all the tribal heads of Israel.
He gathered the family leaders of the Israelites.
He called them to Jerusalem.
He wanted to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
The ark was in Zion.
Zion is the City of David.
passages.original: אָז֩ יַקְהֵ֨יל שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת־ זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְאֶת־ כָּל־ רָאשֵׁ֨י הַמַּטּ֜וֹת נְשִׂיאֵ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְֽהַעֲל֞וֹת אֶת־ אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֛ה מֵעִ֥יר דָּוִ֖יד הִ֥יא צִיּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: So all the men of Israel came together to the king at the feast in the seventh month.
passages.sermon:
All the men of Israel gathered.
They came to the king.
They met during the feast.
This feast happened in the seventh month.
passages.original: וַיִּקָּהֲל֧וּ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ כָּל־ אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּחָ֑ג ה֖וּא הַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃

passages.text: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the Levites took up the ark, and they brought up the ark and the Tent of Meeting with all its sacred furnishings. The Levitical priests carried them up.
passages.sermon:
The elders of Israel arrived.
The Levites took up the ark.
The Levites brought up the ark.
The Levites brought up the Tent of Meeting.
The Levites brought up all the sacred furnishings that were in the Tent.
The Levitical priests carried these items up.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ כֹּ֖ל זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם אֶת־ הָאָרֽוֹן׃ וַיַּעֲל֤וּ אֶת־ הָאָרוֹן֙ וְאֶת־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵ֥י הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּאֹ֑הֶל הֶעֱל֣וּ אֹתָ֔ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: There, before the ark, King Solomon and the whole congregation of Israel who had assembled with him sacrificed so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon stood before the ark.
All the people of Israel gathered with him.
They stood together as a congregation.
They offered sacrifices to God.
They sacrificed sheep and oxen.
They sacrificed so many animals that no one could count them.
No one could number the sheep and oxen because there were so many.
passages.original: וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה וְכָל־ עֲדַ֧ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הַנּוֹעָדִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו לִפְנֵ֣י הָאָר֑וֹן מְזַבְּחִים֙ צֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יִסָּפְר֛וּ וְלֹ֥א יִמָּנ֖וּ מֵרֹֽב׃

passages.text: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, beneath the wings of the cherubim.
passages.sermon:
The priests carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
They brought the ark to its place.
They placed the ark in the inner sanctuary of the temple.
This inner sanctuary is called the Most Holy Place.
They set the ark beneath the wings of the cherubim.
passages.original: וַיָּבִ֣יאוּ הַ֠כֹּהֲנִים אֶת־ אֲר֨וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֧ה אֶל־ מְקוֹמ֛וֹ אֶל־ דְּבִ֥יר הַבַּ֖יִת אֶל־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקְּדָשִׁ֑ים אֶל־ תַּ֖חַת כַּנְפֵ֥י הַכְּרוּבִֽים׃

passages.text: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed the ark and its poles.
passages.sermon:
The cherubim are angelic beings.
The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark.
The cherubim covered the ark with their wings.
The cherubim also covered the poles of the ark from above.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֤וּ הַכְּרוּבִים֙ פֹּרְשִׂ֣ים כְּנָפַ֔יִם עַל־ מְק֖וֹם הָאָר֑וֹן וַיְכַסּ֧וּ הַכְּרוּבִ֛ים עַל־ הָאָר֥וֹן וְעַל־ בַּדָּ֖יו מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃

passages.text: The poles of the ark extended far enough that their ends were visible from in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are there to this day.
passages.sermon:
The ark of the covenant had poles.
The poles were long.
The ends of the poles could be seen from in front of the inner sanctuary.
People could not see the ends of the poles from outside the Holy Place.
The poles are still there to this day.
passages.original: וַֽיַּאֲרִיכוּ֮ הַבַּדִּים֒ וַיֵּרָאוּ֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הַבַּדִּ֤ים מִן־ הָאָרוֹן֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַדְּבִ֔יר וְלֹ֥א יֵרָא֖וּ הַח֑וּצָה וַֽיְהִי־ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the LORD had made a covenant with the Israelites after they had come out of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
The ark was a sacred container.
The ark held only two tablets.
Moses placed these two tablets in the ark at Horeb.
The LORD gave these tablets to Moses at Horeb.
At Horeb, the LORD made a covenant with the Israelites.
The LORD made this covenant after the Israelites came out of Egypt.
passages.original: אֵ֚ין בָּֽאָר֔וֹן רַ֚ק שְׁנֵ֣י הַלֻּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּחֹרֵ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ עִם־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃פ

passages.text: Now all the priests who were present had consecrated themselves regardless of their divisions. And when the priests came out of the Holy Place, all the Levitical singers—Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and relatives—stood on the east side of the altar, dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals, harps, and lyres, accompanied by 120 priests sounding trumpets.
passages.sermon:
All the priests were present.
All the priests had consecrated themselves.
The priests did not keep to their divisions.
The priests came out of the Holy Place.
All the Levitical singers stood on the east side of the altar.
The Levitical singers included Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun.
Their sons and relatives also stood with them.
The singers wore fine linen.
They played cymbals, harps, and lyres.
One hundred twenty priests stood with them.
These priests sounded trumpets.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֕י בְּצֵ֥את הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים מִן־ הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כִּ֠י כָּל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַֽנִּמְצְאִים֙ הִתְקַדָּ֔שׁוּ אֵ֖ין לִשְׁמ֥וֹר לְמַחְלְקֽוֹת׃ וְהַלְוִיִּ֣ם הַמְשֹׁרֲרִ֣ים לְכֻלָּ֡ם לְאָסָ֡ף לְהֵימָ֣ן לִֽ֠ידֻתוּן וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֨ם וְלַאֲחֵיהֶ֜ם מְלֻבָּשִׁ֣ים בּ֗וּץ בִּמְצִלְתַּ֙יִם֙ וּבִנְבָלִ֣ים וְכִנֹּר֔וֹת עֹמְדִ֖ים מִזְרָ֣ח לַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעִמָּהֶ֤ם כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ לְמֵאָ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים מַחְצְרִרִים בַּחֲצֹֽצְרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The trumpeters and singers joined together to praise and thank the LORD with one voice. They lifted up their voices, accompanied by trumpets, cymbals, and musical instruments, in praise to the LORD: “For He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.” And the temple, the house of the LORD, was filled with a cloud so that the priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud; for the glory of the LORD filled the house of God.
passages.sermon:
The trumpeters and singers joined together.
They made one sound.
They praised the LORD.
They thanked the LORD.
They lifted up their voices.
They played trumpets, cymbals, and other musical instruments.
They praised the LORD, saying, “He is good. His love lasts forever.”
The temple is the house of the LORD.
A cloud filled the temple.
The priests could not stand to serve because of the cloud.
The glory of the LORD filled the house of God.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י כְ֠אֶחָד לַמַּחֲצֹצְרִים וְלַמְשֹֽׁרֲרִ֜ים לְהַשְׁמִ֣יעַ קוֹל־ אֶחָ֗ד לְהַלֵּ֣ל וּלְהֹדוֹת֮ לַיהוָה֒ וּכְהָרִ֣ים ק֠וֹל בַּחֲצֹצְר֨וֹת וּבִמְצִלְתַּ֜יִם וּבִכְלֵ֣י הַשִּׁ֗יר וּבְהַלֵּ֤ל לַיהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְהַבַּ֛יִת מָלֵ֥א עָנָ֖ן בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ וְלֹא־ יָֽכְל֧וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים לַעֲמ֥וֹד לְשָׁרֵ֖ת מִפְּנֵ֣י הֶעָנָ֑ן כִּֽי־ מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃פ
